definition.name: NXoperando_monopd

symbols.doc: Symbols used in dimension declarations. Each symbol binds within a single group instance: nP may differ between scan subentries and nE between electrochemistry series.

symbol.name: nP
symbol.doc: Number of points in one azimuthally averaged 1D diffraction pattern.

symbol.name: nE
symbol.doc: Number of points in one electrochemistry time series.

definition.doc: Application definition for operando powder diffraction of electrochemical cells with a monochromatic X-ray or neutron source. A single entry holds the experiment-level instrument and sample description together with the full electrochemical cycling record; each diffraction acquisition is a sequentially numbered NXsubentry (scan_000001, scan_000002, ...) modelled on NXmonopd, carrying the electrochemical state of the cell during that acquisition.

attribute.name: default
attribute.doc: Name of the NXdata group to visualise first, typically operando_electrochemistry.

field.name: definition
field.doc: Official NeXus NXDL schema to which this file conforms.

field.name: program_name
field.doc: Name of the program that generated this file (provenance).

group.name: process
group.doc: Provenance of the diffraction–electrochemistry correlation: the generating program and the parameters used to match each diffraction acquisition to the electrochemical record.

field.name: data_source
field.doc: Origin of the diffraction data.

field.name: correlation_method
field.doc: absolute: diffraction and electrochemistry clocks are synchronised and matched on absolute timestamps. relative: streams are aligned on elapsed time from their respective starts (unsynchronised clocks).

field.name: echem_time_tolerance
field.doc: Maximum accepted distance between a scan timestamp and its matched electrochemistry point.

field.name: twod_included
field.doc: Whether 2D detector images are embedded in the scan subentries.

field.name: twod_max_display_size
field.doc: Downsampling limit applied to embedded images; 0 means full resolution.

attribute.name: target
attribute.doc: HDF5 path of this group; marks it as the original that the per-scan instrument soft links point to.

group.name: edf_metadata
group.doc: Verbatim harvest of the source EDF header; exempt from validation.

group.name: synchrotron_metadata
group.doc: Verbatim harvest of the source synchrotron NeXus metadata; exempt from validation.

field.name: description

group.name: operando_electrochemistry
group.doc: Full electrochemical cycling record of the operando experiment. Time is stored as elapsed seconds with the absolute origin in the start attribute (NXlog convention), enabling both plotting and re-correlation against the scan subentries.

group.name: standard_electrochemistry
group.doc: Additional electrochemistry files associated with the experiment but not time-correlated with the diffraction data (e.g. formation cycles), one NXdata group per source file.
One source file, named file_NNN (file_001, file_002, ...).

group.name: SCAN
group.doc: One group per diffraction acquisition, named scan_NNNNNN with a zero-padded sequence number (scan_000001, scan_000002, ...). The measurement setup is invariant during the experiment: by convention each subentry carries an HDF5 soft link named "instrument" to the experiment-level /entry/instrument group rather than a copy. (Declared here as documentation only: NXDL links cannot be optional, and file validators do not traverse soft links.)

field.name: definition
field.doc: Ratified technique definition this subentry is modelled on. Deviations from NXmonopd (NX_NUMBER data, errors field) are documented at the top of this definition; NXoperando_monopd is the authoritative schema for the subentry contents.

group.name: environment
group.doc: Electrochemical state of the cell during this acquisition.

field.name: voltage
field.doc: Cell voltage at the electrochemistry point nearest the midpoint-adjusted scan timestamp.

field.name: voltage_min
field.doc: Minimum cell voltage over the acquisition window [start_time, end_time].

field.name: scan_timestamp
field.doc: Acquisition timestamp as recorded by the diffraction instrument.

field.name: midpoint_adjusted_timestamp
field.doc: Timestamp shifted to the middle of the exposure; used for the nearest-neighbour match.

field.name: voltage_timestamp
field.doc: Timestamp of the matched electrochemistry point.

field.name: echem_index_first
field.doc: First index (0-based) of the acquisition window within the operando_electrochemistry arrays.

field.name: echem_index_last
field.doc: Last index (0-based, inclusive) of the acquisition window within the operando_electrochemistry arrays.

group.name: voltage_log
group.doc: Voltage segment spanning the acquisition window, for long acquisitions.

group.name: data
group.doc: The azimuthally averaged 1D pattern. Required whenever a 1D pattern exists for the acquisition; scans recorded as 2D images only carry an image_source reference (and optionally image_data) instead. Each subentry must hold at least one of data / image_source (not expressible in NXDL; enforced by the writer).

attribute.name: oned_source_file
attribute.doc: Basename of the source azimuthally averaged file.

field.name: polar_angle
field.doc: Scattering angle (two-theta) of the azimuthally averaged pattern.

field.name: data
field.doc: Azimuthally averaged intensities. Relaxed from NXmonopd's NX_INT to NX_NUMBER: these are processed, not raw counts.

field.name: errors
field.doc: Propagated intensity uncertainties (Sigma_I).

group.name: image_source
group.doc: Reference to the raw 2D detector image this pattern was reduced from. Large images are referenced rather than duplicated; a downsampled copy may be embedded in image_data for preview purposes.

field.name: type
field.doc: MIME type of the source, e.g. application/x-hdf5.

field.name: embedded
field.doc: Whether a copy of the image is embedded in image_data.

field.name: max_display_size
field.doc: Downsampling limit applied to the embedded copy; 0 means full resolution.

field.name: original_shape
field.doc: Shape of the original image before downsampling.

group.name: image_data
group.doc: Embedded (possibly downsampled) copy of the 2D detector image.
